relationships.subject: tilapia piscidin 3
relationships.evidence_quote: IT TP3 significantly increased phosphodiesterase 4D (PDE4D) levels and decreased the expression of cAMP, brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF), and tumor necrosis factor-α in astrocytes within the dorsal horn

relationships.subject: tilapia piscidin 3
relationships.evidence_quote: intrathecal (IT) administration of TP3 alleviated CCI-induced mechanical allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia

relationships.subject: rolipram
relationships.evidence_quote: The antinociceptive effects of TP3 were abolished by the PDE4D inhibitor rolipram

key_findings: Intrathecal TP3 alleviates CCI allodynia and hyperalgesia, raising PDE4D and lowering cAMP, BDNF and TNF-α in dorsal horn astrocytes; rolipram abolishes the effect.
